rank_verification.source: CoinMarketCap historical snapshots via Internet Archive Wayback Machine (free, no API key)
rank_verification.methodology: For each Binance-UM perp symbol, the earliest Wayback CMC historical snapshot at or after the symbol's earliest Binance Vision S3 markPriceKlines zip date (formation date) was used as the point-in-time rank evidence. Rank stability was assessed as rank spread across all snapshots containing the symbol. A symbol is rank_verified=true iff it appears in at least one snapshot at/after its formation date with a numeric cmcRank. This is a coverage-cohort verification, not a claim that the rank held continuously; ranks are snapshot-based only.
rank_verification.coverage_limitation: 24 of 25 candidate snapshot dates returned parseable CMC pages; 2020-03-01 is a dead 418-byte Wayback stub (HTTP 200, no body) and was excluded. Formation dates without any archived CMC historical page (2019-12-23, 2020-01-06, 2020-01-15, 2020-01-17, 2020-02-04, 2020-07-10, 2020-10-14 confirmed no capture in prior CDX audit) are covered by the next available later snapshot, which is a conservative upper bound on rank (rank can only fall after listing, not rise before it).
